$comment: Debrief's CI contract (./dev plan, ADR 0014 §6). Debrief is not a leg of ci.yml: its gates (Rust on Linux and macOS, plugin SDK, licences, frontend, e2e, real-app smoke on three OS, installers, the release) are its own workflow, .gitea/workflows/debrief.yml, whose plan job asks `./dev plan --ci --app debrief`. Its nightly jobs are debrief-bench, -corpus, -fuzz and -mutants.yml.
